answer: Counterparty diversity: reputation counts only when counterparties are diverse, starving closed sybil clusters. Entry costs a 50 POA bond; rewards count only if 12 of the last 20 counterparties are unlinked. Minting 100 fakes costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA, yet their trades loop like a river circling a reef, so the check zeroes their rewards. One honest ember across strangers keeps burning: honest agents pay one bond and keep full rewards.
